$comment: Item table. Contract: docs/GDD.md 'Items and currency' + 'Weapons'. Owned by the `game` agent. equip_slots is the character panel's slot set (Phase 11.7, GDD 'Equipment'). Shipped to clients in the `defs` message; never duplicated in the client.

items.name: Pulse Rifle
items.desc: Hitscan pulse rifle. 30-cell magazine, falls off past 40 m.

items.name: Energy Cell
items.desc: Energy cells for the pulse rifle. Stack to 300.

items.$comment: Phase 5: owning this item IS owning a ship (GDD 'Ownership') - the server spawns the owner's ship on the pad at purchase and on join. stack_max 1: one ship per owner.
items.name: Scout Ship
items.desc: Your own ship, parked on the pad. Owning it is flying it.

items.name: Scout Helmet
items.desc: Sealed visor, cracked in one corner. Keeps the dust out.

items.name: Scout Suit
items.desc: Patched pressure suit. Most of the patches are yours.

items.name: Scout Leggings
items.desc: Reinforced at the knees, where you land.

items.name: Scout Gloves
items.desc: Grip on the palms, no feeling in the fingertips.

items.name: Scout Boots
items.desc: Magnetic soles, switched off. They squeak.

items.name: Scout Pack
items.desc: A frame pack with room for everything you have not found yet.

items.name: Rabbit's Foot
items.desc: It was not lucky for the rabbit.

items.$comment: Phase 12 tools: the first residents of the `tool` slot (GDD 'Materials, tools, and the bag'). A node names the tool it needs; `supersedes` lets a better tool stand in.
items.name: Hand Drill
items.desc: Drills iron out of ore nodes. Three seconds a bite.

items.name: Plasma Cutter
items.desc: Cuts scrap out of wrecks. Mind the sparks.

items.name: Drill Mk II
items.desc: Bites copper. Crafted, not sold.

items.$comment: Phase 12 materials: stackable, sellable, and the ONLY things that spill on death (GDD 'Death spills the raw').
items.name: Iron Ore
items.desc: Raw iron. Heavy for what it is.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.desc: Green-streaked and worth the walk.

items.name: Scrap
items.desc: Cut from a wreck. Somebody's ship, once.

items.name: Iron Chest Plate
items.desc: Bench-made. Heavier than the suit and it shows.

items.$comment: Phase 13 consumable (GDD 'use'): one unit leaves the bag, +50 health capped, 8 s cooldown. Bench-made and stocked by the quartermaster.
items.name: Medkit
items.desc: Gauze, gel and a shot of something. Fifty points of not dying.

items.$comment: Phase 13 gadget with the first ability: `use` while worn pings every node and drop within range onto the compass.
items.name: Ore Scanner
items.desc: Listens for metal. Worn on the belt, fired from the bar.

items.$comment: Phase 13 weapon mods (GDD 'Weapon mods'): slot `mod`, additive deltas applied to whatever primary is worn, one at a time.
items.name: Long Barrel
items.desc: Forty more metres before the pulse forgets where it was going.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.desc: Ten more cells between reloads.

items.name: Overcharged Coil
items.desc: Five more points per pulse, and a smell of hot copper.

entity_defs.$comment: One def serves every EntityTypeNPC. It was authored for the Phase 2 shopkeeper and `damageable` stayed false when Phase 3 added hostile NPCs, which made every camp grunt and gunner immune to gunfire: ResolveShot skips a non-damageable entity outright, so the camp could be shot at forever and never cleared. Hostiles are damageable; the shopkeeper stays immune because its archetype has no max_health, so it spawns at 0 health and ResolveShot's dead-entity guard drops it before this flag is ever read. max_health here is unused for NPCs - a placement takes its pool from the npcs.json archetype.

Phase 4 rover. Not damageable: no criterion shoots it, and a destroyed only-vehicle would strand the playable proof. The hitbox exists for interaction targeting only - vehicle collision is the origin point (GDD).
Phase 5 ship. Same reasoning as the rover: not damageable, origin-point collision, hitbox for interaction targeting only.

Phase 12 node (ore/wreck). Not damageable: yields are taken with a tool, not a rifle. max_health here is unused - a placement takes its pool from nodes.json `yields`. The hitbox is for interaction targeting.
